event_summary: A silver wrench-shaped flat object moves across the front edge of a black round device and then leaves the visible area while the other objects remain still.
raw_event_description: The video opens on a wooden tabletop with a black round device on the right, a small tilted metallic object with a purple hanging strip on the left, and a silver wrench-shaped object lying across the front/top edge of the black device. Over time, the silver object shifts leftward along the device's front edge while its angle changes. Near the end it reaches the left side of the black device and then is no longer visible. The black device, cord, tilted metallic object, and purple strip show no visible position change.

reasons: The black round device, silver wrench-shaped object, left metallic object, purple strip, tabletop, and cord are visible.
The silver object is already positioned on the front/top edge of the black round device.
